newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson fuels rebound in Swedish share prices.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson fuels rebound in Swedish share prices.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket closed with gains on Tuesday with telecoms giant Ericsson fuelling a rebound after losses in morning trade but the main influence coming from the U.S. ahead of the election.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.77 percent to 2139.41, boosted by a higher open in New York in afternoon trade.
Turnover was about average with shares worth 3.36 billion crowns changing hands.
"For the time being we are doing everything that the U.S. does as they are better at analysing the election over there than we are," said one broker.

A winner of the day was Ericsson which closed four crowns higher at 189 crowns, dragging the engineering index up 1.23 percent higher. It announced a 2.6 billion crown digital mobile telephone contract with China.
The bank sector rose 1.33 percent. S-E-Banken rose 1.5 to 57 crowns after reporting operating profit in the first nine months of 1996 more than doubled to 4.42 billion crowns.
Foreningsbanken posted a seven percent rise in nine month operating profit. It closed 0.20 higher at 27.20 crowns.
Swedbank is due to report on Wednesday.
